1.consolidated_definition: Reformar, reconstruir, reestructurar. Modificar algo, en general con la intención de mejorarlo. Anglicismo adaptado, usual. DRAE 2001, del inglés. En febrero de 1998 la empresa remodelará ese local, incluyendo los pisos, la decoración y el área de la panadería (El Nuevo Día, 28-11-97)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
To reform, reconstruct, or restructure something; to modify it in general with the intention of improving it. Adapted anglicism, commonly used. 

Note: In this context, "anglicismo" refers to a loanword from English that has been incorporated into the Spanish language. The term is specific to Puerto Rican Spanish and refers to words or phrases borrowed from English.

In this translation, I have preserved the formal tone and academic style of a dictionary while maintaining the precise meaning of the original definition.
